message.reasoning_content: Dig a Pony is Paul (Ringo? no—Dig a Pony lead vocal: John). Sure to Fall: Beatles version, lead by... Beatles BBC version lead vocal? It's Paul? Actually "Sure to Fall" Beatles cover, lead vocal by... Paul and John? I think Paul sang lead. I Just Don't Understand? Not a Beatles song. I'm Only Sleeping: John. Answer: Sure to Fall, Paul.
